name: Kendi
summary: Clean grey-paper online magazine in black Inter: big tight hero headline, full-width featured story slider, then a two-column feed with a sticky-feeling sidebar of topics, newsletter and ads.

fonts.pairing: Inter 600 at -0.03em for every heading, Inter 500 for paragraphs and meta

signature: 72px tight two-line headline with a short intro and inline subscribe field opposite it, above a full-width featured story with category chip and overlaid title
main feed plus right sidebar with an image-tile topic grid, newsletter card, numbered spotlight list and a sponsored card
imagery: moody editorial photography: portraits in foliage, night streets, travel landscapes, tech close-ups; small square thumbnails
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 30px side padding, 740px main column plus about 400px sidebar, 100px between feed blocks, 5 to 10px radii
